contract.scope: Shared envelope/version/exact-key/transport safety contract; Go intentionally does not verify config integrity or actual worker transport.
contract.expansion: Replace $CONFIG with configJson verbatim, then append ASCII spaces to padToBytes when set. Both tests consume these exact expanded JSON bytes.
contract.url: HTTPS absolute URL with hostname and valid port/percent escapes; no userinfo, raw whitespace/control/backslash, query or fragment delimiters; maximum 2000 UTF-16 units. Preserve input, do not normalize.
contract.model: Nonempty, maximum 256 UTF-16 units, no U+0000..U+001F or U+007F; preserve input.
contract.bytes: Maximum 262144 UTF-8 bytes; Go additionally rejects invalid UTF-8 before JSON decoding.

cases.name: object config is opaque to Go
cases.integrityOnly: Go checks object shape; TypeScript requires a complete normalized Bifrost config.

cases.name: disabled provider with matching digest
cases.integrityOnly: Provider integrity belongs to TypeScript even with a matching config digest.

cases.name: wrong admitted config digest
cases.integrityOnly: Go validates only the spec digest shape, not its relationship to opaque config.

cases.name: actual worker URL mismatch
cases.integrityOnly: Only TypeScript verifies the actual injected transport against the config digest.

cases.name: actual worker model mismatch
cases.integrityOnly: Only TypeScript verifies the actual injected transport against the config digest.
